items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: One guy, a guy named Jack Kelson, he took -- wrote down everything... And he took the money they gave him, but he went to the union... And I told Duke about him when Johnny died.

ctx.x: Montgomery, yeah. They did the same thing to him. Ridiculous people, man. Get you out on the road and lower your salary. You can't get home, you're out somewhere on a bus, you don't know where you are. One guy, a guy named Jack Kelson, he took -- wrote down everything, every job they made and the amount of miles they travelled. And theatres, everything. And he took the money they gave him, but he went to the union and when (inaudible) he quit. And he got thousands and thousands of dollars just for the mileage.…
Yeah, I've heard of mileage, but not--
